decision_conditions: The proposed two storey side extension, by reason of its excessive scale, bulk, and projection significantly beyond the established return building line on Warley Road, would appear as an incongruous, visually intrusive and over dominant addition on a prominent corner plot. The development would disrupt the established pattern, spacing and openness that characterise the locality, failing to respect the form and proportions of surrounding buildings and resulting in harm to the character and appearance of the area. The proposal therefore represents poor design that conflicts with Paragraphs135 of the NPPF (2024), Policies D1 and D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), and Policies DMHB 11 and DMHB 12 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The proposed two storey side extension, by virtue of its scale, height and  projection beyond the established rear building line, would introduce an unacceptable sense of enclosure and a harmful reduction in outlook for the first floor rear windows of the adjoining properties along Uxbridge Road. The extension would infill an area that currently provides openness and daylight to neighbouring dwellings, resulting in materially adverse amenity impacts. In the absence of any daylight and sunlight assessment or technical evidence to demonstrate otherwise, the proposal fails to show that neighbouring amenity would be safeguarded. The development is therefore contrary to Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part Two (2020).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and national guidance.

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension.
